name: Etna
source:
Likes: Living freely
Dislikes: Anyone who ruins her freedom

Overlord Laharl's vassal.
She looks up to the former Overlord, Krichevskoy. To train Laharl to become like him, she is very strict.

She is quick to shoot off her mouth, and she doesn't make an exception for Laharl.

Also, she is always scheming to take Laharl's title.

[From Disgaea Infinite's "Netherworld Database".]
